plan.objective: Compare every completed masked-feature arm with the previously evaluated same-width junction-trained Q branch on identical frozen biological validation examples.
plan.timing: Separate supplemental comparison recorded after masked-feature pretraining began, before its biological metrics were inspected. The ongoing core protocol and its random/coordinate gates are unchanged.
plan.validity: Reference table has already passed independent prediction replay. Require identical target hashes, split sizes, prevalence, chromosome scope and bitwise C+S / C+S+H baseline scores. Require completed, converged new probes, and retain all arms and seeds.
plan.interpretation: Descriptive, adaptively motivated one-fold validation comparison; report every seed and mean/range, without chromosome confidence intervals or changing the core promotion rule.
limitations: Masked-feature budget is up to 20 epochs versus 10 for junction Q; this is not a compute-matched loss-only ablation
Different masking/targets and target normalization are explicit, while inference architecture/input cache/dimension are shared
Does not compare the 48D masked representation to the 96D T+Q composite

scope: Exploratory development validation; no CI; no gate or training change
